{
  "name": "loss_rankgap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Use a rank-based gap loss leveraging the tanh link on the scaled advantage difference, encouraging smooth ranking consistency rather than margin-based classification.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled = alpha * adv_gap\nloss = mean(tanh(clamp(scaled, -10, 10)) * weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "clamp",
    "mean",
    "mul",
    "sub"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    scaled = ops.clamp(ops.mul(alpha, adv_gap), -10.0, 10.0)\n    loss = ops.tanh(scaled)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return loss.mean()"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_000_cost_sum",
  "intuition": "rule_based: pairwise logsigmoid loss with sum aggregation",
  "pseudocode": "loss = -logsigmoid(clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap, -20, 20))\nloss = loss * weight\nreturn sum(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "scale": "1.9496803035382082",
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "cost_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "sum",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",
    "clamp",
    "sum"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "cost_a",
      "cost_b"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.sum(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_rankgap_tanh_advantage_weighted",
  "intuition": "Promote correct ranking by penalizing the tanh-transformed rank gap modulated by the advantage difference, emphasizing stronger preference signals and adaptive weighting.",
  "pseudocode": "loss = mean(weight * softplus(tanh(rank_gap(batch)) * (advantage_l - advantage_w)))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "softplus_tanh",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "softplus",
    "mean",
    "mul",
    "sub"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l",
      "rank_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    rg = batch['rank_gap']\n    # Compute modulated rank gap signal\n    signal = ops.tanh(rg) * (adv_l - adv_w)\n    loss_per_pair = ops.softplus(signal) * weight\n    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)"
}
